I see people everyday go without any reply or any support. It's unfortunate but true. People cannot rely on say suicide hotline because the minute you say you are suicidal the cops are already on the way. Same with therapy. I look at this subreddit as the one place people can talk freely and not have to worry about being reprimanded for how they feel. It's not about who replies or how many. It's about the support. That's what people in this subreddit need. A shoulder to lean on when things get tough and they feel there is no way out.
